en: Wield the Royal Shield in your attack.
zh_official: 在你的攻击中使用御盾。
zh: 在你的攻击中使用御盾。

en: Wielding the ancient Royal Shield, not a single slaver blade found our hero, and the fortress was quickly freed of their foul presence.
zh_official: 挥舞着古老的御盾，不是单个奴隶战士发现了我们的勇士，而堡垒被迅速从他们邪恶的存在中解救出来。
zh: 挥舞着古老的御盾，没有一片奴隶贩子的刀刃能伤到我们的英雄，堡垒也迅速清除了他们邪恶的势力。

en: Storming the gate, you heft the Royal Shield high, blocking all blows from the slavers. You are victorious, and the slaves are freed.
zh_official: 强攻大门，你高举御盾，阻挡了奴隶所有的打击。你获胜了，而奴隶被解救。
zh: 强攻大门，你高举御盾，挡住了奴隶贩子的所有攻击。你获胜了，奴隶们得到了解放。

provenance.v: REVISE: slavers 是“奴隶贩子”，原译“奴隶”漏“贩子”造成指代错误。

en: After an arduous climb, you stand before the slavers' fortress. The sounds of pain and suffering can clearly be heard beyond these walls.
zh_official: 经过艰苦的攀爬，你站在了奴隶的堡垒前。在这些墙以外，能够清楚地听到疼痛与痛苦的呻吟声。
zh: 经过艰苦的攀爬，你站在了奴隶贩子的堡垒前。墙内清晰地传来痛苦与苦难的声音。

provenance.v: REVISE: slavers' 指奴隶贩子；“beyond these walls”指墙后/墙内，非“在这些墙以外”。

en: The trail of clues led our hero to a mountaintop fortress, where cries of anguish carried far on harsh, bitter winds.
zh_official: 循着这串线索，我们的勇士走到了一处山顶堡垒，里面发出极度痛苦的哭声随着严酷、刺骨的寒风传到了远处。
zh: 循着这串线索，我们的英雄走到了一处山顶堡垒，里面发出极度痛苦的哭声随着严酷、刺骨的寒风传到了远处。

en: A most vile rumor had spread throughout the land: the king was enslaving his own people! Our hero resolved to get to the bottom of things.
zh_official: 一个十分邪恶的传言传遍了这片土地：国王在奴役自己的臣民！我们的勇士决定弄清事情真相。
zh: 一个十分邪恶的传言传遍了这片土地：国王在奴役自己的臣民！我们的英雄决定弄清事情真相。

en: I don't want to believe it, but rumor is our king is enslaving his own people! Maybe you could find out more...
zh_official: 我不想相信，但是有传言称我们的国王在奴役他自己的臣民！也许你能够了解更多...
zh: 我不想相信，但是有传言称我们的国王在奴役他自己的臣民！也许你能够了解更多……

en: The Fortress Above
zh_official: 高处堡垒
zh: 高处堡垒

en: Draw your weapon and battle the Bane.
zh_official: 拿起你的武器，与贝恩一战。
zh: 拿起你的武器，与贝恩一战。

en: When our hero clashed against the evil beast, a torrent of corrosive Rot nearly slew <hero_name>, forcing them to flee in failure.
zh_official: 当我们的勇士与邪恶的野兽交战时，大量腐蚀性腐化几乎杀死了<hero_name>，迫使他们落荒而逃。
zh: 当我们的英雄与邪恶的野兽交战时，大量腐蚀性腐化几乎杀死了<hero_name>，迫使他们落荒而逃。

en: Clashing against the Bane proves to be your undoing. Pierced by tendrils of pure evil, you're nearly consumed by the Rot.
zh_official: 失败的原因在于与贝恩交战。你被纯邪恶的卷须刺穿，几乎快被腐化吞噬了。
zh: 与贝恩交战成为了你的败因。你被纯粹的邪恶卷须贯穿，几乎被腐化吞噬。

en: The battle that ensued would go down in Armellian history as one of the greatest the land had ever seen. The Bane's evil was cleansed.
zh_official: 随之而来的战斗将载入阿门罗史册，成为这片土地上发生的最伟大的事件之一。贝恩的邪恶被净化了。
zh: 随之而来的战斗将载入阿门罗史册，成为这片土地上发生的最伟大的事件之一。贝恩的邪恶被净化了。

en: With honed fighting skills worthy of the northern wolves' best, you emerge victorious, freeing the town.
zh_official: 你拥有几经锤炼的战斗技能，值得与北方狼群最勇猛的狼交手，你夺得了胜利，解放了这座城镇。
zh: 你拥有几经锤炼的战斗技能，堪与北方狼族最杰出的勇士媲美，你夺得了胜利，解放了这座城镇。

provenance.v: REVISE: worthy of the northern wolves' best 表示技能可与北方狼族顶尖者媲美，不是“值得与……交手”。

en: Lead the townspeople to safety.
zh_official: 带领镇民来到安全的地方。
zh: 带领镇民来到安全的地方。

en: Knowing the Bane's evil touch would be all-corrupting, <hero_name> helped the townsfolk escape their doomed village.
zh_official: <hero_name>知道贝恩的邪恶之触无所不腐，便帮助镇民逃离了劫数难逃的村庄。
zh: <hero_name>知道贝恩的邪恶之触无所不腐，便帮助镇民逃离了劫数难逃的村庄。

en: The village is lost to the Bane, so you insist the townsfolk leave their village behind and move on to safer locales.
zh_official: 村庄落到了贝恩的爪中，因此，你坚持要求镇民离开他们的村庄并转移到更安全的地方。
zh: 村庄落到了贝恩的爪中，因此，你坚持要求镇民离开他们的村庄并转移到更安全的地方。

en: Fight back with the Bane's Blade
zh_official: 用贝恩之刃杀回去
zh: 用贝恩之刃杀回去

en: Our hero understood the Rot. Their blade dripped with it. They met the charge head on and slew the Bane. The villagers did not emerge.
zh_official: 我们的勇士了解腐化。他们的刀刃充盈着腐化。他们冲锋在前，并干掉了贝恩。村民们没有出现。
zh: 我们的英雄了解腐化。他们的刀刃滴淌着腐化。他们正面迎上冲锋，干掉了贝恩。村民们没有出来。

en: You leap into the air and meet the charge head on. Rot blade clashes with Rot blade, but you are the stronger. You cut the beast down.
zh_official: 你一跃而起，并冲锋在前。腐化之刃碰撞腐化之刃，而你更强大。你击倒了野兽。
zh: 你一跃而起，迎面冲向冲锋。腐化之刃与腐化之刃相击，但你更强大。你击倒了野兽。

provenance.why: 半句英文未译，整句补译
半句英文未译，整句补译

en: Swing with the Moon Scythe
zh_official: 挥舞月之镰刀
zh: 挥舞月亮镰刀

译文准确，术语与格式合规

en: Bane's were no longer the terrifying danger they had once been. Our hero's journey was reaching its end. <our_hero> felled it in one strike.
zh_official: 贝恩不再是像曾经那样可怕的危险。我们勇士的征途到达了终点。<our_hero>一击制胜。
zh: 贝恩不再是像曾经那样可怕的危险。我们英雄的征途到达了终点。<our_hero>一击制胜。

en: In one mighty strike, you reap the Bane in half. It falls apart. The Wyld surges around you, filling you with magic.
zh_official: 在强大的一击之下，你将贝恩一刀两断。它四分五裂。怀尔德笼罩在你身边，让你充满魔法。
zh: 在强大的一击之下，你将贝恩一刀两断。它四分五裂。怀尔德笼罩在你身边，让你充满魔法。

en: The village is abandoned! Or rather, the townsfolk are hiding indoors. You quickly discover why as a deadly Bane descends from the rooftops!
zh_official: 村庄被遗弃！或者更确切地说，镇民都躲在室内。当致命的贝恩从屋顶上降落下来时，你很快明白了原因！
zh: 村庄被遗弃！或者更确切地说，镇民都躲在室内。当致命的贝恩从屋顶上降落下来时，你很快明白了原因！

zh_official: 村庄空无一物，或者说看起来是这样。<hero_name>很快发现镇民生活在致命的恐惧之中——贝恩在附近潜伏着。
zh: 村庄空无一物，或者说看起来是这样。<hero_name>很快发现镇民生活在致命的恐惧之中——贝恩在附近潜伏着。

zh_official: 最近几周，附近的这座小村庄一直都没有消息。我们的勇士知道这种情况下可能很不妙，于是开始朝这个村庄赶去。
zh: 最近几周，附近的这座小村庄一直都没有消息。我们的英雄知道这种情况下可能很不妙，于是开始朝这个村庄赶去。

zh_official: 几周都没有听到有关附近一个聚落的消息了。我有朋友在那儿...也许你可以去看看？
zh: 几周都没有听到有关附近一个聚落的消息了。我有朋友在那儿……也许你可以去看看？

zh_official: 不幸的是，我们的勇士无法转变队长的忠诚。遭遇了失败的尴尬之后，<hero_name>空爪而归。

zh_official: 幸运的是，我们的勇士极具说服力。队长很快就开始歌颂狼族并为它们提供援助。

zh_official: 威胁足以帮助我们的勇士与队长达成临时联盟。有一点帮助肯定比没有强。

zh_official: 我们的勇士被迫干掉队长。<hero_name>无法抵挡更多的敌人。宝座如此之近，真不凑巧！

en: The artifacts our hero had gathered on their journey were double edged. <hero_name>'s Winged Boots lead them astray. The Stone was lost.
zh_official: 我们的勇士在他们的征途中收集的文物是把双刃剑。<hero_name>的翅靴将他们带入歧途。灵石弄丢失。
zh: 我们的英雄在征途中收集的文物是把双刃剑。<hero_name>的翅靴将他们带入歧途。灵石丢失了。

en: You take a running jump. Unfortunately, the boots are too powerful. You land leagues away, lost. You're lucky to escape the mire at all.
zh_official: 你跑跳一步。不幸的是，靴子太强大了。你落在了数里格之外，迷路了。你很幸运地完全逃脱了泥潭。
zh: 你助跑起跳。不幸的是，靴子的力量太强。你落在了数里格之外，迷了路。所幸你还是逃出了泥潭。

en: Part the quicksand with the Wyldfyre Staff
zh_official: 用怀尔德法杖分开流沙
zh: 用怀尔德焰杖分开流沙

en: The quicksand of <quest_tile> had been sitting still for centuries. It was impassable. Luckily, our hero found something of use within it.\n
zh_official: <quest_tile>的流沙静静地坐落在这里数百年了。这是不可逾越的。幸运的是，我们的勇士这其中发现了可用的东西。\n
zh: <quest_tile>的流沙已静静沉积数百年，无法通行。幸运的是，我们的英雄在其中有了一个有用的发现。\n

en: The quicksand sluggishly moves, but not enough to let you past. You sag, disappointed, until you spot something gleaming beneath the sand.
zh_official: 流沙缓慢移动，但还不足以让你过去。你垂头丧气，直到你在沙子下面发现了闪闪发光的东西。
zh: 流沙缓慢移动，但还不足以让你过去。你垂头丧气，直到你在沙子下面发现了闪闪发光的东西。

en: Deep into the heart of the foul mire, you see the stone you desire atop a small knoll in the middle of a nasty-looking patch of quicksand.
zh_official: 在肮脏的泥潭中心地带的深处，你看到了想要的灵石，就在一片看起来十分可怕的流沙地中间的一个小山顶上。
zh: 在肮脏的泥潭中心地带的深处，你看到了想要的灵石，就在一片看起来十分可怕的流沙地中间的一个小山顶上。

en: Our hero soon found the heart of the foul mire, and the Spirit Stone they desired. Unfortunately, the stone was surrounded by quicksand.
zh_official: 我们的勇士很快发现了肮脏的泥潭的中心地带，以及他们想要的灵石。不幸的是，灵石被流沙包围着。
zh: 我们的英雄很快找到了肮脏泥潭的中心地带，以及他们想要的灵石。不幸的是，灵石被流沙包围着。

en: The swamp had gained a foul reputation for taking lives, including a recent one with a Spirit Stone. A Spirit Stone our hero desired...
zh_official: 这片沼泽曾因夺走了许多生命而臭名昭著，包括最近一次卷走了一块灵石。我们的勇士想要得到的灵石...
zh: 这片沼泽因夺走性命而臭名昭著，最近连一块灵石也被卷走。我们的英雄想要的正是那块灵石……

en: A few travelers have tried to make it through that swamp nearby... none have survived. Could've sworn one of 'em had a Spirit Stone.
zh_official: 一些旅行者试图穿过附近的沼泽...但无一幸存。我发誓他们当中一个拿着灵石。
zh: 一些旅行者试图穿过附近的沼泽……但无一幸存。我发誓他们当中有一人带着灵石。

en: Commune with the Wyld.
zh_official: 与怀尔德亲密交谈。
zh: 与怀尔德沟通。

en: And indeed, not even the Wyld would deign to help such a pitiful beast. Our hero was forced to slay it, leaving the keep with a heavy heart.
zh_official: 事实上，即使是怀尔德，也不会屈尊帮助这个可怜的野兽。我们的勇士被迫杀死了它，让城堡主楼背负一颗沉重的心。
zh: 事实上，即使是怀尔德，也不会屈尊帮助这个可怜的野兽。我们的英雄被迫杀死了它，心情沉重地离开了城堡主楼。

en: The Wyld ignores you -- a terrible quiet. The Rot-infested wolf nearly rips you to shreds, but your training help you emerge as the victor.
zh_official: 怀尔德忽略了你——可怕的安静。被腐化感染的狼几乎将你撕成了碎片，但你的训练却帮助你成为了胜利者。
zh: 怀尔德忽略了你——可怕的安静。被腐化感染的狼几乎将你撕成了碎片，但你的训练却帮助你成为了胜利者。

en: But our hero refused to give up. Begging the Wyld for aid, the wolf warrior was freed of her curse, and rewarded <hero_name> greatly.
zh_official: 但是我们的勇士不愿放弃。狼战士乞求怀尔德的援助，被解除了诅咒，并为<hero_name>提供了丰厚的奖励。
zh: 但我们的英雄不愿放弃。狼战士乞求怀尔德的援助，被解除了诅咒，并给<hero_name>提供了丰厚奖励。

en: A bright flash fills the lair, and the wolf is freed of her curse. She is grateful, and offers you her most prized treasure as thanks.
zh_official: 巢穴里充满闪光，狼摆脱了她的诅咒。她感激不尽，送给你她最宝贵的宝藏作为感谢。
zh: 巢穴里充满闪光，狼摆脱了她的诅咒。她感激不尽，送给你她最宝贵的宝藏作为感谢。

zh_official: 我们的勇士接受了这个可怕的真理，与被腐化的狼发生了冲突，杀死了它，挽回了狼族在阿门罗的声誉。
zh: 接受这个可怕的事实后，我们的英雄与被腐化逼疯的狼交战，杀死了它，挽回了狼族在阿门罗的声誉。

en: The beast puts up a good fight, but stands no chance against your onslaught. The reputation of the wolf clan is no longer sullied.
zh_official: 野兽展开殊死战斗，但仍然没有机会对抗你的猛攻。狼族的声誉不再受到玷污。
zh: 野兽展开殊死战斗，但仍然没有机会对抗你的猛攻。狼族的声誉不再受到玷污。

zh_official: 炼金师用一瓶纯白的东西化险为夷。治愈了腐化。我们的勇士将其灌进狼的喉咙，拯救了他。

zh_official: 这次是无气泡药水。一瓶纯白的东西。你进行攻击，并将药水灌进了动物的喉咙。腐化被烧掉了。

zh: 抽干野兽的腐化

zh_official: <hero_name>跟踪着这个生物来到了它那堆满骨头的巢穴，就在那个古老的城堡主楼里。曾经骄傲的战士似乎难以拯救。

en: One of the Wolf Clan had been turned by the corrupting power of the Rot. The time had come for our hero to free them of their madness.

zh_official: 我不希望传播有关狼族的坏消息，但有传言称，你自己当中的一个被腐化扭曲，在附近一座城堡主楼里杀害了许多无辜的生灵。
zh: 我不想传播狼族的坏消息，但据说你们的一个同类被腐化扭曲，正在附近一座城堡主楼里杀害无辜生灵。

zh_official: 我们的勇士向怀尔德求援，但它忽视了他们的请求。一大批蜘蛛开始降下来，<hero_name>逃离了沼泽。
zh: 我们的英雄向怀尔德求援，但它忽视了他们的请求。一大批蜘蛛开始降下来，<hero_name>逃离了沼泽。

zh_official: 你向怀尔德求援，但它却什么也不听。你感到胸部疼得厉害，也知道腐化的罪恶正在这个泥潭自由游荡。

zh_official: 厚厚的蜘蛛网很快就被怀尔德撕裂开了，释放了通往熊萨满的通道。深受打动的她将宝藏给了<hero_name>。
zh: 厚厚的蛛网很快被怀尔德撕裂，通往熊萨满的道路畅通了。深受触动的她将一件宝藏赠予<hero_name>。

en: In a moment, the webs are torn asunder by vines erupting from the swamp. The bear shaman is impressed, and offers you a treasure.
zh_official: 不一会儿，蜘蛛网被从沼泽喷发出来的藤蔓撕开。熊萨满深受折服，因此给你了一个宝藏。
zh: 不一会儿，蜘蛛网被从沼泽喷发出来的藤蔓撕开。熊萨满深受折服，因此给你了一个宝藏。

zh_official: 熊的话向你漂过来："国王很快就会被推翻。狼族必须准备好统治这个地方。"你离开了，感觉自己更有智慧了。
zh: 熊的话语向你飘来：“国王很快就会倒台。狼族必须准备好取而代之。”你离开了，感觉自己更有智慧了。

en: "These are creatures of the Rot. I'll take care of them."
zh_official: "这些都是腐化的动物。我会照顾他们。"

en: Please note: New subscriptions are no longer available for purchase. If your payment lapses or you cancel your Subscription, you will not be able to re-Subscribe through any means.\nSubscriptions grant access to premium content, including all Heroes, all Hero Skins, The Bandit Clan, Seasons Board Skins, all Premium Dice, all Novellas. Subscribers also gain access to exclusive, evolving subscriber Badge and Dice and a 10% discount on Chests! Please note that subscriptions in Armello will be charged on your iTunes account after purchase. Your membership or subscription will renew automatically if you do not cancel at least 24 hours before the renewal date. Your subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase. Should your subscription lapse, purchased content will persist, however all content granted via subscription will be inaccessible until subscription is renewed.
zh_official: 新订阅已不再提供购买。阿门罗的每月订购费，订购授予访问优质内容，包括所有勇士、勇士皮肤、强盗族、季节图板皮肤、所有优质骰子和所有短篇故事。订购者也可以访问专有的、不断更新的订购者徽章和骰子以及 10% 的箱子折扣！请注意，如果订购阿门罗，将从您的 iTunes 账户收费。请于续订日期前 24 小时取消续订，否则，您的会员身份或订购将会自动续订。可以管理您的订购，在购买后前往您的账户设置可以关闭自动续订。如果您的订购过期，购买的内容将保留，但是通过订购授予的所有内容将不可访问，直至再次续订。
zh: 请注意：新订阅已不再提供购买。如果你的付款中断或取消订阅，将无法通过任何方式重新订阅。\n订阅可访问高级内容，包括全部英雄、全部英雄皮肤、强盗族、季度桌面皮肤、全部高级骰子和全部中篇小说。订阅者还可获得专属且不断进化的订阅者徽章和骰子，以及宝箱 9 折优惠！请注意，在阿门罗中订阅后将从你的 iTunes 账户收费。若未在续订日期前至少 24 小时取消，你的会员身份或订阅将自动续订。购买后可前往账户设置管理订阅或关闭自动续订。如果订阅中断，已购买的内容将保留，但通过订阅授予的所有内容在续订前将无法访问。

en:
Prestige is key to holding political sway in the Kingdom of Armello. Each Dawn the King will call upon the Prestige Leader to advise him on that day's King's Declaration.

Additionally, should the King die of his illness, the Prestige Leader will be named his rightful heir to the throne (winning the game).

Gain Prestige by performing heroic deeds.
zh_official:
威望是在阿门罗王国掌控政治影响力的关键。每个黎明，国王都会召集威望领导者，就当天的国王宣言发表建议。

此外，如果国王因病而亡，威望领导者将成为王位的合法继承者（在游戏中胜出）。

通过做出英勇事迹获得威望。
zh:
声望是在阿门罗王国掌控政治影响力的关键。每个黎明，国王都会请声望领先者就当天的国王宣告献策。

此外，若国王病逝，声望领先者将被指定为王位的合法继承人（赢得游戏）。

通过完成英勇事迹获得声望。

zh_official: 腐化是终极腐蚀。如果随意应付黑暗艺术，或是过着乏味的生活，你可能也会感受到腐化的黑暗控制。\n\n具有腐化的勇士首先遭到感染。如果继续走这种黑暗的道路，他们就会腐蚀。
zh: 腐化是终极的堕落。亲近黑暗法术或过着不检点的生活，你也可能落入腐化的黑暗魔掌。\n\n拥有腐化的英雄会先变为已感染。继续投身这条黑暗之路，他们将变为已堕落。

en:
When posting a bug don't say what should be happening. Don't post it as a question. Just say what's wrong.

Good: "The player hero is running on the spot and game has locked up."

Bad: "Hero should be able to move freely."

Bad: "Um, should this be happening? I can't play the game."
zh_official:
在发布错误时，请不要说应该发生什么。不要将它作为问题发布。只需要说哪里出问题了。

好的示例："玩家勇士正在游戏场景中奔跑，游戏突然锁定了。"

不好的示例："勇士应该可以自由移动。"

不好的示例："嗯，这应该发生吗？我没法玩游戏了。"
zh:
在发布错误时，请不要说应该发生什么。不要将它作为问题发布。只需要说哪里出问题了。

好的示例：“玩家英雄正在原地奔跑，游戏已经锁死。”

不好的示例：“英雄应该可以自由移动。”

不好的示例：“嗯，这应该发生吗？我没法玩游戏了。”

provenance.v: REVISE: EN 引号示例应使用中文引号“”；\n\n 后不应多出空格
REVISE: 漏译“on the spot”（原地），且“游戏突然锁定了”不如“游戏已经锁死”准确。

en:
Twiss, or Little Lightpaw as she was once known amongst the prestigious ranks of the thieves’ guild, began her life in the Royal Capitol. Born in the slums, she was forced to steal to survive. It didn't take long before her natural talent at thievery flourished. Soon, burglary was her way of life.

Twiss is a notorious thief. Many of Armello's richest citizens live in fear of receiving the telltale acorn calling card she leaves after daring heists. Twiss herself knew no fear at all until the King, in one of his first acts of madness, and in a state of fevered paranoia, ordered a great purge of his city's thieves. Twiss barely escaped the purge with her life, and was forced to seek refuge amongst a new family, the Bandit Clan.

Now Twiss' ambitions for an ever more daring heist have fixed on the summit of power in Armello. With so many contenders in the mix, and with the stakes never higher, what a joy it would be to see a once clanless slum cub take the throne from all the merry nobles who squabble for it. She's armed with a wooden sword for when things get dangerous, an acorn for when she gets hungry, and a sense of humour so mischievous it borders on the wicked. Twiss now stakes her claim for the throne. Can anyone steal it from her?
zh_official:
特威斯，也就是曾经在窃贼集团中享负盛名的小光爪，在皇家国会大厦开始了她的生活。她出生在贫民窟里，为了生存被迫偷窃。没过多久，她偷窃的天赋便展现出来。很快，入室盗窃成了她的生活方式。

特威斯是有名的小偷。许多阿门罗最富有的市民都生活在恐惧之中，他们害怕收到她在大胆抢劫后留下的泄密橡子召唤卡。特威斯天不怕地不怕，直到有一天国王开始了疯狂的行动，他狂热偏执地下令对城市的小偷进行大清洗。特维斯几乎没能逃过这一劫，于是被迫寻求一个新的庇护——强盗族。

现在，特威斯更野心勃勃的抢劫计划锁定在了阿门罗的权力峰会上。这混战中竞争者如此之多，风险如此之高，如果这曾经没有任何庇护的贫民窟幼童能从所有为王位趋之若鹜的贵族手中将其夺取，那将是何等的乐事。她带着木剑以防危急时刻，带着一颗橡子防止饥饿，同时也带着她几近邪恶调皮的幽默感。特维斯现在宣布了她对王座的所有权。有人能从她手中将其偷走吗？

en:
Sylas is dead. The essential spark of joy in his heart was snuffed out when his home and family were reduced to ashes before his eyes. Left for dead in the muddy water around the ruins of his former life, whatever creature he had been before - a father, a husband, a fisherman - died in those moments, as he drifted away into the dark.

Who was behind this heinous act? None other than the King's Guards. Punishing Sylas for the theft of a legendary rainbow fish from the King's rivers.

It would take some time for his body to recover, and even longer for the legend of a merciless otter dealing death to the King's loyal subjects to spread far and wide enough to be recognized as a single individual. But now, none dare speak the name Sylas for fear that the fisher of souls might come for them, as he has for so many others.

Ambition and vengeance are not common bedfellows. But Sylas has found a way to marry the two into a drive for the throne that puts noble passions to shame. He is a wanting King of spite. A figure who will do anything to ease the wrongs of his past by inflicting terrible vengeance on those he deems responsible.

Armed with a spear, and a burning fire in his belly, this cold blooded killer stalks the land, waiting for his time to strike and take what is rightfully someone else's.
zh_official:
西拉斯已死。当他的家和家人在他眼前被活活烧死时，他心中最重要的那一点点欢乐之光就被扼杀了。以前生活过的地方已成废墟，他已死在这废墟周围泥泞的水中。不管他以前扮演着什么角色——父亲、丈夫、 渔夫——在他漂至黑暗之中时都已死了。

是谁操控了这一起穷凶极恶的行动？除了国王卫队，别无他人。为了惩罚西拉斯从国王的河流中偷走了一条传说中的彩虹鱼。

他的身体需要一些时间才能恢复。如果一只无情的水獭杀死了国王忠诚的臣民，这需要相当长的时间才足以被后人传为是一个人将那些臣民杀死。而他的身体恢复所需的时间甚至比这还久。但现在，没有人敢提西拉斯这个名字，人们害怕这收割灵魂的渔民会为他们而来，就像他对许多人做过的事情一样。

野心和复仇不太经常同时出现。但西拉斯已经找到了一种方法，结合两者成为夺取王座的动力，让高尚的激情变得羞耻。他是一位心怀怨恨的国王，愿意不惜一切代价，对他认为有责任的人进行残忍复仇，来弥补他过去的错误。

手持利矛，心怀怒火，冷血的杀手潜伏在这片土地上，等待时机来夺取本应属于他人的东西。

en:
During the time of great peace over which the King ruled, many of the more savage elements of Armello's history were erased in favour of peace. Knights, who were brutal and unforgiving warriors, found a certain poetic romanticism that drove them to do good deeds, and protect the innocent, rather than claim riches and fame. Horace, the Iron Poet, was the paragon of this romantic era.

Horace spent his youth and his legendary strength lending hands to those in need, and protecting the noble King at all costs. Despite the years of hard work and battle, a spark of light always stayed lit in the badger's eye. In recent years, as the King grew colder, and the land more savage, that sense of joy faded from many in the King's Guard, and indeed throughout the rest of Armello. Only Horace kept the light burning.

One night, a battalion of King’s Guards were dispatched to arrest Horace for daring to voice his concerns about the King. They found his humble barracks room empty. Horace was long gone. Seeing the impending disaster, he had been left with no choice but to abandon his past life. Now, deemed bandit, Horace searches for a way to turn the falling kingdom back, and set it once again on its true course of love, and peace.
zh_official:
在国王统治的伟大和平时期，为了和平，阿门罗历史上许多更为野蛮的东西被抹除。骑士本是残酷无情的战士，但某种诗意的浪漫主义情怀驱使他们行善并保护无辜的人民，而不是要求财富和名望。作为硬铁诗人，贺拉斯是这个浪漫时代的典范。

贺拉斯把他的青春和他那传奇的力量用来帮助那些需要帮助的人，不惜一切代价保护着高贵的国王。尽管多年努力工作和战斗，但他的眼睛里总是闪耀着一丝光芒。近年来，随着国王越来越冷血，土地越来越荒蛮，国王守卫以及阿门罗其他人心中的欢乐逐渐消失。只有贺拉斯还残留着一线光芒在燃烧着。

由于贺拉斯敢于向国王表达了他的担忧，一天晚上，国王派他的守卫去逮捕他。他们发现他简陋的军营里空无一人。贺拉斯早就走了。眼看着灾难即将来临，他别无选择，只有抛弃过去的生活远走高飞。现在，被认为是强盗的贺拉斯在寻找可以使堕落的王国回到过去的方法，希望再次让其回到真正的爱与和平的道路上。

en:
Scarlet was born to a wealthy, but unloving father. His drunken and cruel antics were so severe that he eventually lost her in a game of cards. She was taken in by a dalmatian named Slantfang, King of The Raiders of the Ashen Forest, one of the seven bandit tribes of Armello.

Displaced from high society into a band of ruffians, Scarlet was forced to fight for survival. She spent years as the subject of Slantfang’s mockery, but kept her keen eyes open throughout. Once she had gleaned the skill to rule a bandit tribe, she faked her own death and vanished, only to return years later to oust Slantfang, with the might of the six other tribes at her back.

As the representative of the disenfranchised and exiled of Armello, Scarlet is the voice of all those who the Kingdom have failed. She fights for a truer and kinder future, where drunken fathers, misfortune, or a vile king, cannot so foolishly destroy the lives of their dependents.
zh_official:
斯卡利特的父亲富有但毫无父爱。他酗酒并行为残忍，最终在一场纸牌比赛中输掉了她。她被一个名叫“歪牙”的达尔马提亚人收养，这人是“苍白森林突袭者”（阿门罗七大强盗群落之一）的国王。

从上流社会被迫加入一群流氓，斯卡利特被迫为生存而战。多年来她一直是歪牙嘲笑的对象，但她始终睁大着双眼，保持着敏锐。 她找到统治强盗群落的技巧后，就假装死亡，消失了。多年后，倚仗着其他六个群落的力量，她回来驱逐了歪牙。

斯卡利特代表着所有被剥夺了公民权以及从阿门罗驱逐的人们，为所有对王国失望的人们发声。她为一个更真实、更美好的未来而奋斗，希望到那个时候醉酒的父亲、不幸的人们以及邪恶的国王都不能如此愚蠢地摧毁别人的生活。
zh:
斯卡蕾特的父亲富有但毫无父爱。他酗酒并行为残忍，最终在一场纸牌游戏中输掉了她。她被一个名叫歪牙的达尔马提亚人收养，这人是灰烬森林突袭者（阿门罗七大强盗部族之一）的王。

从上流社会跌落进一群恶棍之中，斯卡蕾特被迫为生存而战。多年来她一直是歪牙嘲笑的对象，但她始终睁大着敏锐的双眼。在她摸清统治一个强盗部族的门道之后，便假死脱身、销声匿迹，多年后倚仗其他六个部族的力量归来，驱逐了歪牙。

作为阿门罗所有被剥夺权利与遭到放逐者的代表，斯卡蕾特为所有被王国辜负的人发声。她为一个更真实、更仁慈的未来而战——在那里，醉酒的父亲、飞来的厄运或邪恶的国王，都无法如此愚蠢地摧毁他们家人的生活。

en:
In the depths of the sacred woods which house the ancient home of the Bear Clan, grow a thicket of holy trees. Within their warm embrace, Sana was delivered as a cub. The legends say she was raised by druids, and was the subject of an ancient prophecy. Despite these lofty supposed beginnings, her life is one of peace and contemplation.

For the Bear Clan, those most in tune with the Wyld hold the divine responsibility of overseeing the growth of their kin. In their meditations, they find the answers to dire threats presented to the Bear Clan, and to Armello as a whole. As such, Sana has found herself forced into a position of guardianship for the whole of her clan.

Sana discovered the greatest threat to ever walk Armello. The King. Now a bastion of corruption, the once noble creature that united the clans haunted Sana's nightmares, and drove her to join the quest for the throne, with the might of the bear clan following behind her.

Sana, the Forest Sister, is a peaceful being. Her natural inclination towards peace and the Wyld make it difficult for her to thrive in the bloody struggle for the throne. Still, she persists, determined to fulfil the duty her clan, and the Wyld itself, has placed upon her.

Now awoken, the great guardian of the Bear Clan will do anything to protect the Wyld.
zh_official:
在神圣的树林深处坐落着熊族的古老家园，这里生长着一丛圣树。萨那还是幼崽的时候，在它们温暖的怀抱中送了过来。传说她是德鲁伊抚养长大的，并且预示着一个古老的预言。尽管有这些崇高的开始，但她的生活充满着和平与思考。

对于熊族来说，那些与怀尔德最一致的人肩负着照看其亲属成长的神圣责任。冥想中，他们找到了熊族和整个阿门罗所面临的可怕威胁的答案。于是，萨纳发现自己被迫被置于守护整个种族的境地。

她发现了阿门罗内最大的威胁——国王，曾团结了萨那噩梦般的种族，现在是腐败的堡垒，驱使着她加入夺取王座的斗争中，熊族的力量是她坚强的后盾。

森林姊妹萨那爱好和平。她对和平和对怀尔德的天然偏好使她难以在为王位争权夺利的斗争中兴旺发达。不过她还是决心履行种族和怀尔德给她的责任。现在，熊族的伟大守护者将不顾一切保护怀尔德。
zh:
在神圣的树林深处坐落着熊族的古老家园，这里生长着一丛圣树。萨娜尚是幼崽时，便被送进了这片温暖的怀抱。传说她由德鲁伊抚养长大，且是一个古老预言的主角。尽管起点如此崇高，她的生活却始终宁静而充满沉思。

对熊族而言，与怀尔德最契合的人肩负着照看族人成长的神圣职责。他们在冥想中寻找答案，以应对熊族乃至整个阿门罗面临的可怕威胁。于是，萨娜发觉自己被推上了守护全族的位置。

她发现了阿门罗有史以来最大的威胁——国王。那位曾团结诸族的高贵存在如今已成腐化的堡垒，化作萨娜的梦魇，驱使她踏上争夺王座之路，熊族的力量紧随其后。

森林姊妹萨娜是个爱好和平的存在。她天性倾心和平与怀尔德，这让她难以在血腥的王座之争中如鱼得水。但她依然坚持，决意履行族人与怀尔德托付给她的使命。

如今已然觉醒的熊族伟大守护者，将不惜一切守护怀尔德。

en:
Years of combat take a toll on the soul and the body. For each scar that marks the flesh, another indelible wound is placed upon the spirit of the wounded being. Brun, the Scarcaster, is amongst the most experienced warriors in Armello. Despite his age, and the many scars which litter his body, the primal force within him now rises to the challenge of a dark king on a fallen throne.

Brun is part of the ancient Bear Clan order of the Scarcasters. These titanic warriors draw power from ritualistic carvings that they, and others, inflict upon themselves. Brun channels the most primal aspects of the Bear Clan. The side that rejects peace and harmony with the rest of Armello in favour of a more pure and animalistic way of life. The modern Bear Clan largely rejects this practice, and Brun has been cast out of his homeland for his primal ways. If placed upon the throne, he would herald in an age of more savage, but ultimately perhaps, freer, and more pure, life.

A young burning soul in the body of an aged titan, Brun spent his life growing up in the shadow of a mighty and noble King. Now, as that fabled ruler turns to darkness, Brun strides forth to share the benefit of his savage wisdom with the whole of Armello.
zh_official:
多年的战斗对灵魂和身体都造成了伤害。每一处肉体的伤疤，都将在受伤者的精神上添置一个无可磨灭的创伤。疤痕施法者布朗是阿门罗最有经验的战士。尽管他年事已高，身上还有许多伤痕，但他内心的原始力量现在却不断涌动，挑战黑暗国王坠落的王座。

布朗是远古熊族疤痕施法者团体的成员。这些巨大的战士和其他人给他们身上造成了颇具仪式感的疤痕，而他们从这些疤痕上汲取能量。布朗引导着熊族最原始的一方，为了更纯粹兽性的生活方式，拒绝与阿门罗和平和谐共处。现代的熊族基本上拒绝了这种做法，而布朗由于自己原始的方式被赶出了家园。如果他拥有王位，他将带来更加野蛮的时代，但也许其生活将更自由、更纯粹。

布朗年迈的身体里藏着年轻热烈的灵魂。他的一生都是在一个强大而高贵的国王的阴影下成长的。现在，那个传说中的统治者投身于黑暗，布朗大步向前迈进，与整个阿门罗人分享他野蛮智慧的好处。

en:
Ghor doesn't quite know why he's joined the race for the throne. He doesn't really understand why it's so important, or why some cheer his name and others jeer him. Ghor is a peaceful being and a simple bear, caught up in something so much larger than he understands. But, Ghor may be Armello's next King.

Bear Clan legend states that once every age, a conduit for the Wyld is born in Armello. Many strive to earn that power, but blind ambition will lead them nowhere. The Wyld chooses those who do not seek to abuse its power. Ghor is the conduit of this age. He carries power beyond even the most dedicated practitioners of magic. A power he has no understanding of, and deeply fears. He was not chosen for his skill, his wisdom or devotion. He was chosen because of his simplicity.

The conduit has been selected. None shall stand in the way of Armello's most mighty warrior.

Probably...
zh_official:
古尔不太清楚为什么自己加入了王座之争中。他不明白为什么王座如此重要，也不明白为什么有人为他欢呼，也有人嘲笑他。古尔是爱好和平且简单的熊，但却陷入了超出他理解范围外的事情。不过，古尔可能是阿门罗下一任国王。

熊族传说指出，每一个时代，阿门罗都会诞生一个怀尔德的中转人。许多人努力想获得这种力量，但盲目的野心将使他们无路可走。怀尔德人选择了那些不滥用力量的人。古尔就是这个时代的中转人。他对这力量一无所知，却深深惧怕。他不是因为他的能力、智慧或敬业精神而被选中的。他之所以被选中，是因为他的简单。

中转人已被选中。没有人可以阻碍阿门罗最强大的战士。

也许……

en:
Magic is a complicated craft. Many who try their hands at it find themselves quickly overcome by the strangeness. Dig too deep and you risk losing those same hands, or more, as the forces you play with become less stable and more volatile. Throughout history, few have mastered the craft as completely as Yordana.

Born long before the King arrived in Armello, Yordana was an outsider even amongst the esoteric Bear Clan. Her study of the Wyld, and its many forms, bordered on the profane. Rather than deal with those precious fools who would hold her back from progress, she isolated herself from the rest of her kind, only emerging during times of great crisis to spit wisdom and counsel to those in power.

Her drive for the throne is as inscrutable as her mastery of magic. Although none can say why the clever bear wants to rule, her path to the crown will be the final ingredient in a concoction of life that will change the face of Armello forever.
zh_official:
魔法是一种复杂的技能。许多尝试过的人都会发现自己很快就被奇怪的事物所征服。由于你捣鼓的力量变得越来越不稳定、反复无常，所以挖掘得太深的话，你就有可能失去双手或者更多其他的东西。纵观历史，很少有人像尤尔达娜那样完全掌握这门技能。

早在国王到达阿门罗之前，尤尔达娜就出生了，即便是不对外开放的熊族中也是个局外人。她对怀尔德及其多种形式的研究，近乎亵渎。她没有和那些没价值的傻瓜打交道，那些人只会拖后腿。她把自己与其他同类隔离开来，只在大危机时期出现，向当权者灌输智慧和忠告。

她想要王座的驱动力就如同她对魔法的掌握一样高深莫测。虽然没有人知道为什么聪明的熊想要统治权，她夺取皇冠的道路将成为生活这个混合物的最后一味要素，永远改变阿门罗的面貌。

en:
Volodar is the chosen one of the Dragon Clan. He is the high prophet of the Worm, the arch whisperer of its divine will, the beacon that guides the remaining strength of his once great clan towards a new and brilliant future.

Although, his intentions may not be so forthright.

It is true that Volodar hears the voice of the Worm in his dreams. It is true that he understands its will, and can bring its terrible power to bear. But Volodar may be more concerned with his own delights, preaching convenient fables in the name of his god that happen to serve his interests. He will utilise any tool, scheme, or soul, divine and otherwise, to take the throne.

Born into his powerful role, and raised as a voice of the divine from infancy, this Komodo Dragon cares nothing for his subjects. Before his will, Armello will yield, or tumble screaming into the dark.
zh_official:
福洛达尔是龙之部落中的天选之人。他是蠕虫的高阶先知，也是蠕虫圣意的最高低语者，更是指路的信标，带领他曾无比强大的部落中的剩余部众走向新的辉煌未来。

不过，他的意图也许并没有这么直白。

不过，福洛达尔确实会在梦中听到蠕虫的声音，这一点是真的。他也确实能理解它的意志，并将它可怕的力量化作现实。但福洛达尔可能更加关心自己的享受，假借自己的神明之名，传播方便自己的寓言，为自己的利益大开绿灯。他为了夺取王座，不惜利用任何工具、任何阴谋、任何灵魂、任何神明，无所不用其极。

这只生来便身居高位、作为神明之使者被抚养长大的科摩多龙，根本毫不关心自己的子民。在他的意志之下，阿门罗大陆只有两个选择，要么屈服，要么尖叫着堕入黑暗。

en: It is said, long ago when the great clans still hunkered away in their ancestral homes, and before the hidden places of Armello had been laid bare, Agniya served the Worm. She is likely the oldest being in Armello. Blessed with a prodigious level of the Dragon Clan's natural healing affinity, this ancient, lumbering behemoth has survived as a warrior for longer than any memory, including her own, can recall.\n\nWhen the Dragon Clan began its pilgrimage from Armello, Agniya lead the voyage as a vanguard. She is the only creature who still remembers that distant time of Dragon Clan supremacy, although the spark of that memory is obscured by the dust of many ages. Now, returned to the land of her birth, she sees that despite all these years, no great ruler, no avatar of her beloved Worm, or great bringer of peace has arrived. Even the greatest of patience wears thin. In the absence of someone better, the responsibility falls to Agniya to rule. A duty avoided for aeons untold now comes crashing down on this turtle's sturdy shoulders.
zh_official: 据说在很久以前，各个伟大的部落尚在祖先之地聚居，阿门罗的隐藏之地也尚未显现之时，雅戈尼娅就已经在侍奉蠕虫了。她大概是阿门罗最古老的存在了。这位上古之人天赋异禀，具有龙之部落天生与治疗的亲密关系。这位迟缓而巨大的战士，生存的经历已经远远超出了任何生灵的记忆，连她自己也是一样。\n\n龙之部落从阿门罗踏上朝圣之路时，雅戈尼娅便是这旅程中的先锋。她是唯一一个尚对龙之部落鼎盛统治拥有记忆的存在，但这记忆的火花，也被世世代代积累的灰尘淹没了。现在，回到出生之地的她却看到，尽管已过了这么多年，仍没有出现一个伟大的统治者、她敬爱的蠕虫的化身，也没有什么和平的使者出现。就算最深沉的耐心，也终有其限度。既然没有更佳的人选，这统治的责任便落到了雅戈尼娅的肩上。几个纪元以来被推卸、被躲避、从未揭示的职责，就这样重重落在了这只巨龟坚实的肩膀上。

en:
There must be a balance. Life and death, beginnings and endings. For one to exist, the other must too, and the ebb and flow between the two extremes is what makes us whole.

It's an easy concept to preach about, but when the time comes to stop sowing the fields, and to let the flourishing magic of the Wyld fade in favor of the harsher putrefaction of the Worm, few people are willing to step forward and do what's necessary. Oxana is one of the few who understands the balance. She has devoted her life to its balance, and to the most extreme example of its practice; the hunting of the Wyld's avatars, the druids.

Oxana is the only creature pragmatic enough to see that the Wyld is growing too powerful. Peace does not mean cutting out the Rot, it means encouraging the chaotic harmony. Such a task might seem impossible to most, but Oxana is a sentinel, one of the last members of a dying sect, devoted to maintaining the balance. Highly trained, highly skilled, and highly deadly, Oxana follows her duty in the most practical way possible, ascending to the throne where she might best oversee what her predecessors have failed to achieve.
zh_official:
这其中，一定会有平衡点。生与死，始与终。为了其中一极与另一极的存在，必须会在两极之间不断起落、流动，也正是这，让我们变得完整。

这个概念说起来容易，但当我们真的要停止耕作、为了令蠕虫更加衰败而放任怀尔德精妙丰饶的魔法日渐消逝之时，很少有人会有站出来行必须之事的勇气。只有少数人明白这平衡之理，欧夏娜便是其中之一。她的一生都献给了平衡，也无时无刻不在追寻着平衡中哪怕最极端的手段：狩猎怀尔德的化身——德鲁伊。

欧夏娜是个极其实际的存在，也只有她看出了怀尔德的力量已经过于强大。和平的意义，并非彻底切除腐化，而是鼓励实现混沌的和谐。在大多数人看来，这根本是个不可能的任务。但欧夏娜是一名哨兵，作为这个即将消亡的宗派中最后的成员之一，她决定献身于守护平衡。欧夏娜训练严谨、技巧精熟、威力强劲，一向以最实用的办法完成自己的职责，甚至走上了王座，以求最好地完成前任者们未能完成的任务。

en:
As the centuries rolled by, and the Dragon Clan faded further from Armello's memory, their tales and legends fell by the wayside and became enshrouded in myth. The few remaining Dragons left their prized banners to museums, and the regalia of an ancient age slowly faded away.

Some, like Nazar, could not stand idly by and watch such a tragedy take place.

Born in Armello, Nazar devoted his life to the study of the ancient ways of the Dragon Clan. Operating from the shadows, this zealot breathed life into the embers of a fallen tradition and received maddening visions from the Worm as a result. This madness only served to steel his conviction further. Where cunning, stealth and guile could not liberate lost relics and fulfil ancient prophecies, he saw to it that blood would. His enemies', his own; it doesn't matter to the Worm.

When the Dragon Clan returned, emerging from dark corners of Armello and beyond, it was a sign. Armello's future is carved into Nazar's very flesh; the heretic will die.
zh_official:
几百年过去了，龙之部落也在阿门罗的记忆中逐渐消逝。他们的故事与传说渐行渐远，陷入了神秘。少数剩下的巨龙，也将他们荣耀的旗帜留在了博物馆，作为一段逐渐逝去的上古时代的见证。

其中一些巨龙，比如纳扎尔，不甘心就这样眼睁睁看着如此的悲剧发生。

纳扎尔出生于阿门罗，一生致力于研究龙之部落的古老传统。这位狂热分子一向在暗中活动，为失落传统的余烬重新点起了生命的火焰，并因此看到了令人疯狂的蠕虫幻象。而这疯狂，只让他进一步坚定了自己的判断。当狡诈、隐匿与欺骗无法偷得失落的文物、实现古代预言时，他便会用鲜血解决一切问题。敌人的鲜血，他自己的鲜血；对蠕虫来说，这无关紧要。

龙之部落回归时，从阿门罗的黑暗角落与更远处，出现了预兆。阿门罗的未来已经刻入了纳扎尔的血肉之中；异教徒必须死。

en:
Amber is an explorer at heart. Born into a noble family who rapidly fell from grace and then struggled to put food on the table, Amber found her talents at discovery useful. She took easily to the somewhat ill-regarded art of dungeoneering, and made a living by pawning off stolen and pillaged items from ancient tombs. Eventually, her skill at such business allowed her to reverse the family fortune, and punish the wicked Proudclaw clan, who had cast her family so low.

Amber is a talented Rabbit. She is wise, but strong, and has enough respect for the balance of the Wyld that it has yet to cause her any trouble in her adventures. Alongside this healthy balance of skills, she has an excellent talent for political machinations. She can spin a yarn with a foppish noble, or share a meal with an uncouth bandit.

With the fortune of her family restored, Amber now looks towards the Kingdom as a whole. Her keen sense of duty pricked, and her sense for adventure following suit, she casts herself into the race for the throne with abandon, ready to take the challenges as they come, and surmount each one.
zh_official:
安布尔的内心十个冒险家。她出生在一个贵族家庭，但迅速失势，必须自力更生维持生活。在寻找有用的东西上天赋异禀。她很容易就喜欢上了有点不受人尊敬的地下艺术，靠典当古墓里被盗和被掠夺的物品谋生。最终，她在这种生意上的技能使她恢复了家庭的财富，惩罚了打击她家族的种族——邪恶的普劳福特族。

安布尔是个又天赋的兔子。她机智而强壮。怀尔德的平衡暂未给她的冒险带来任何麻烦，她尊敬这个平衡。除了这种健全的技能平衡，她还在政治阴谋上还有过人的天赋。她可以与纨绔子弟一起纺纱，也可以与粗野的强盗一起吃饭。

随着家族的财产得到恢复，安布尔现在把目光投向了整个王国。她敏锐的责任感被刺痛后，冒险感随之而来。她尽情投入到王座争夺战中，准备到时侯越每一次挑战。

en:
Barnaby's true age is a matter of hot debate. It is also a topic of derision amongst his opponents, right up until his specially designed hammer crunches into their skulls.

Child prodigy, humorist, mad inventor, and contender to the throne, Barnaby's chance at victory rests upon his specially designed armour. The young Rabbit has taken the instinct of burrowing to a new level, by building an impenetrable suit of armour, from which he journeys through the perilous wilds of Armello, safe and sound.

Little is known of Barnaby's past, precisely because there is so little of it that has taken place. What matters to this Rabbit is the future. Not just his own, but of the Kingdom's at large. Having already amassed a fortune and a renown that would satisfy most full grown adults, the passion that drives Barnaby forward comes from deeper within. A sense of duty perhaps? The lust for a challenge? Or, maybe just a sense of fun and adventure.

At any rate, those villains of Armello that hear the telltale sound of clanking and clanging stalking them through the woods should remember, never hit a child. Unless he hits you first.
zh_official:
关于巴纳比真实年龄的讨论一直没有停止。这也是他的对手嘲笑他的话题，直到他专门设计的锤子砍入他们的头骨才停止。

从神童、幽默作家、疯狂的发明家到王座继承人，巴纳比获胜的机会取决于他专门设计的盔甲。这只年轻的兔子把挖洞的本能提升到了一个新的高度。他建造了一套坚不可摧的盔甲，使他穿过阿门罗危险的荒野仍安然无恙。

人们对巴纳比的过去所知甚少，因为真正发生了的事情太少。对这只兔子来说，重要的是未来——不仅仅是他自己的，同时也是王国的未来。在积累了足以满足大多数成年人的财富和名望后，巴纳比内心深处的激情去试着他前进。也许是责任感？也许是对挑战的渴望？亦或许只是一种乐趣和冒险感？nn无论如何，那些听到在树林里传来叮当作响声的阿尔梅罗恶棍应该铭记，不要攻击一个孩子，除非你先遭受攻击。

en:
Behind every great barrow hidden across the Rabbit Clan plains are a group of craftmasters and architects that lend their knowledge to bolster the power of the great kingdom. Elyssia is one of these masters in the shadows, but unlike them, she can be found at the front of each great barrow too.

Elyssia is the Warden of Warrens, one of the most vital posts in the burrows. She's responsible for its defence against all enemies. Although an engineer and architect, this rank gives her enormous political sway, enough to bully her way around with impunity. She works, toils, and guides others to do the same. Under her wary supervision, and skilful implementation, many of the Rabbit Clan's most ambitious projects have been realised. There is a place for those lonely artists held up in workshops developing tiny trinkets. But Elyssia's dreams are bigger, and there is yet to be one that she has not achieved.

Amid the chaos of the battle for the throne, Elyssia emerges as a pragmatic candidate. What she has done for the Rabbit Clan alone is staggering. Her ambition is tempered by a loyalty to the artistic nature of her craft. Her creative soul is tempered by an unrivaled work ethic. With all the great clans united under her banner, the future of Armello is unlimited.
zh_official: 藏匿在兔族平原古坟之后的是一群工匠和建筑师，他们用自己的知识增强这个伟大王国的力量。艾尔希娅既是阴影中的大师之一，但与之不同的是，在每一个大古坟都有她的身影。她负责抵御所有敌人的进攻。虽然是工程师和建筑师，但这个级别给了她巨大的政治影响力，足以让她大施拳脚而不受惩罚。她辛勤地指引着他人也像她那么做。在她谨慎的监督以及娴熟的实施下，许多兔族最具野心的项目都得以实现。在开发小饰品的工坊里，有孤独的艺术家的一席之地。但艾尔希娅的雄心壮志远非如此，她还有一个尚未实现的梦想。\n\n在争夺王座的混乱中，艾尔希娅成为了一个务实的候选人。她为兔族所做的一切令人震惊。她忠于自己手艺的艺术性，野心也为之削减。她富有创造力的灵魂被无与伦比的职业道德所冲淡。当所有伟大的种族团结在她的旗帜下后，阿门罗的未来不可度量。

en:
Hargrave Proudclaw was an eccentric figure in the once mighty Proudclaw Clan. A brilliant tactician, dedicated soldier, and devious inventor, his bravery and skill formed much of the basis for his family’s meteoric rise to power within the labyrinthine world of Rabbit Clan politics. As he reached the greying age, and settled to rest his feet by the fire throughout his winter years, he was shocked to see his entire family ruined due to the treacherous actions of his young grand-niece, and a young upstart dungeoneer who was far too big for her boots.

Hargrave found himself fallen from grace, tossed into the footnotes of history. Worse still, the added scrutiny upon his house caused the collapse of his final great endeavour, the creation of a series of black powder hand cannons. Hargrave was forced to watch, terrified for the future of the Rabbit Clan without his family's guidance, while the realm fell into chaos. Children, louts, and unabashed uncultured swine fought for the throne and shed the blood of good and noble houses.

No. He would not have it. This is not the way a Proudclaw dies. From the depths of his dusty workshop, he withdrew his most deadly invention, a black powder cannon, long ago outlawed by the King. Weapon in hand, Hargrave mustered what was left of his might and vitality, and cast his own name into the battle for the throne. Perhaps there are those more suited, more powerful, or luckier. But Hargrave has faced longer odds before.

Have at it then! A new challenger is here.
zh_official:
哈格雷夫·普劳福特是曾经强大的普劳福特族中的一个怪人。他是一位出色的战术家、敬职的士兵和狡猾的发明家。他十分骁勇，技巧熟练，为他的家人能在迷宫般的兔族政治世界中迅速崛起、获得权力奠定了很大的基础。当他白发苍苍，在冬天安顿在火边休息之际，他震惊的发现整个家庭被年轻自负的外孙女背叛。

哈格雷夫发现自己跌落神坛，成为历史长河中无关痛痒的一员。更糟糕的是，对他家族的额外审查导致他最后的努力功亏一篑。他没有制成黑火药手炮。哈格雷夫被迫看着兔族失去家族的指导，为兔族的未来担心。然而王国却陷入混乱。他的孩子、不良少年还有厚脸皮无教养的下流胚子争夺着王座，流下高贵家族的血液。

不行。普劳福特族不能就这样死去。从他尘土飞扬的车间深处，他取回了最致命的发明，一种早就被国王宣布非法的黑火药炮。武器在手，哈格雷夫聚集了仅存的力量和活力，在王座争夺战中投入了自己的名字。也许有更合适、更强大或更幸运的人，但哈格雷夫面对过更大的困难。

战就战吧！一个新的挑战者来了。

en:
Mercurio, the grinning blade, is a gutter rat. Like all gutter rats, he was born in the dirt. He has trudged through slime and kissed the dusty soles of every noble who came through the slums he called home. But Mercurio is also an aristocrat. He's slept on fine silken sheets, rubbed shoulders with the Rat Clan elite, and like all nobility, spilled blood for gold.

Mercurio is a rat of extremes. He's made and lost a dozen fortunes throughout his life. He's been the hero of the Rat Clan, and its most wanted criminal. He's wandered throughout Armello and has seen everything the Kingdom has to offer.

Now, there's only one height left for Mercurio to reach.

It takes all kinds to make a kingdom, but only one head can wear the crown. What better head than one that's seen the world from the lowest lows, and the most dizzying heights.

Blade in hand, this dashing rogue now takes his own brand of suave assuredness, and deadly confidence to the race for the throne. Be on your guard, for whenever this rat tends to stride, chaos, laughter, and a healthy dose of scheming follows in his wake.
zh_official:
诡异之刃默丘里奥，是来自下水道的老鼠。和所有的下水道老鼠一样，他出生在泥土里。他艰难地穿过粘液，亲吻着每一个经过他家贫民窟的那些贵族肮脏的灵魂。但默丘里奥也是贵族。他睡在漂亮的丝绸床单上，与鼠族的精英们并肩而行。和所有贵族一样，他也曾为黄金洒热血。

默丘里奥是一只极端的老鼠。他一生中赚过不少钱，也失去过不少。一直是鼠族的勇士，也是鼠族最大的通缉犯。他穿梭于阿门罗，看到了王国所能提供的一切。

现在，默丘里奥只有一个高地需要攻克。

建立一个王国需要各种事物，而头戴皇冠只需一个头。他这头从最低点和令人目瞪口呆的最高点看过这个世界，还有什么比这更好的头呢？nn刀刃在手，这个打扮体面的流氓现在温文尔雅且极度自信走向王座之战。请保持警惕，因为每当这只老鼠将大步前进，混乱、笑声、大量的阴谋将紧随其后。

en:
Rat assassins are amongst the deadliest in the world. Numerous secret orders exist within the hidden alcoves of Rat cities, or isolated at the corners of Armello. Each order is set to constant bickering, and kill each other just as much as their assigned targets.

Zosha kills for the fabled "Night Mother". Who this strange figure is remains a secret even amongst the assassin's guild leaders. Some who have tried to bolster their reputations by claiming her as an agent have found themselves vanished in the night.

Zosha is a master at her craft. She moves through the shadows like liquid, and uses her natural stealth to strike with devastating blows against her targets. Armed with the sacred twin bladed staff of Rat Clan history, she is truly an unstoppable force of careful and precise murder.

Zosha's ascent to the throne comes as another surprise. Those few that knew her before her quest began were shocked to see the creature of shadow throw herself into the public spotlight by beginning her journey. Perhaps her dark mistress, whoever she is, desires her to take control for some strange, nefarious reason. Nobody is sure, except of course, for Zosha.
zh_official:
老鼠刺客是世界上致命的刺客。老鼠的城市中或者阿门罗偏僻的角落隐藏着无数的秘密团体。每一个团体一直在争吵，互相残杀的数量跟他们的任务目标一样多。

佐沙效命于传说中的“夜之母”。这个奇怪的人物是谁？即使在刺客集团首领中也是个秘密。那些称她是间谍来维护自己声誉的人，消失在夜间。

佐沙是她的杰作。她像液体一样穿梭在阴影之中，用她天生的隐身术来打击目标。她装备着鼠族历史上神圣的双刃杖，实施着谨慎精确的谋杀，确实无法阻挡。

佐沙在王座争夺中的攀升是又一个令人惊讶的事。极少数在她计划开始之前就知道她的人，对于这个暗影生物展开旅程，把自己置于公众的聚光灯下，感到震惊。不管她的黑暗女主人是谁，也许她希望佐沙从某种奇怪的邪恶手段中掌握控制权。当然，除了佐沙之外，没有人可以确定。

en:
Sargon, the Veil Walker, is cursed. The grim faced and aged rat devoted his life to the study of the veil, the strange ether that hangs between the void of life and death. His research lasted decades, and his form withered as he forsook the open fields for the darkness of a cave. His constant gaze into the ethereal abyss forever changed his mind. Now, Sargon sees both this world, and the world of the veil. The death of all creatures, and their lives, are revealed to him in vivid waking dreams.

Sargon adores this curse. His study in the more abominable of the arcane arts were a deliberate attempt to draw the ire of strange forces, and corrupt his mind to better understand them. Sargon is the only Armellian with an understanding of the strange ways of the veil, and after decades of bringing his wicked and contradiction laden advice to the fickle rulers of Armello, he now brings his dark expertise to the race for the throne.

Armed with his strange and unique magic, a flair for the dramatic, and a healthy dose of menace, Sargon is a ruler who has touched the beyond. Who dares to risk their lives standing against the alien secrets of the veil walker?
zh_official:
面纱行者萨尔贡被诅咒了。面纱就像是悬于生与死之间的虚空，这只冷酷老迈的老鼠一生都在致力于研究它。他的研究持续了几十年。当他为了一个黑暗洞穴而放弃空旷的田地时，他的身体就衰弱了。 他不断地注视着空灵的深渊，永远改变了自己的想法。现在，萨尔贡既可以看到这个世界，也能看到面纱的世界。万物的生与死都在生动清醒的梦境中向他展示。

萨尔贡喜欢这个诅咒。他研究更可恨的奥术，是为了故意引来奇怪力量的愤怒，腐蚀他的心灵，以便更好地理解这些力量。萨贡是唯一了解面纱奇怪行为的阿门罗人。几十年来，他一直把邪恶而矛盾的建议带给阿门罗多变的统治者。现在他把黑暗的专业知识带到了王座争夺战中。

萨尔贡拥有奇特而独特的魔力，对戏剧性事物的良好嗅觉和大量胁迫手段，是一位触及过死后世界的统治者。谁又敢冒着生命危险反对拥有异族秘密的面纱步行者呢？

en: Griotte is a rat of sophistication. She enjoys the finer things in life. Good food, good company, and good friends to share a meal and a story with. She is also a rat of maniacal violence. She enjoys the rush of battle, the howls of the dying, and the smell of red blood flowing as she takes her enemies apart, cleaver in hand. Of course, she always wears an apron when she kills, lest she ruin a perfectly good dress.\n\nGriotte epitomises the nobility of the Rat Clan. Behind a thin veneer of sophistication and class, lurks a garish, impure, and violent society, ruled by base instinct. She rose through the ranks of this vicious system through a combination of raw cunning, careful timing, and an aptitude for quick and decisive violence. Now, she is one of the most powerful criminal barons in the whole of Armello. Whereas some see the quest for the throne as a dutiful goal, or as a self evident birthright, Griotte views the race as the next step in her bloody ascent. She has no claim other than her power. But that power may very well be great enough to make her Queen.
zh_official: 格莱奥特是一只世故的老鼠，她喜欢生活中美好的事物——可口的食物、美好的陪伴，以及分享大餐与故事的朋友。同时她也是只疯狂暴力的老鼠。她喜欢战斗时的冲刺、垂死挣扎的吼叫，以及用大刀撕裂敌人时，流淌出鲜红血液的气味。当然，她杀人的时候总是穿围裙，以免毁了她美丽的衣服。\n\n格莱奥特是鼠族贵族的缩影。在世故和阶级的外表背后，她靠着基本的本能统领着世俗、不洁、暴力的社会。她天生的狡诈、对时机谨慎的掌握，以及快速果断的暴力才能，让她在这一邪恶体系中脱颖而出。现在，她是整个阿门罗最强大的犯罪大亨之一。有些人视王座角逐为责任目标，还有一些人认为这是与生俱来的权利，但格莱奥特视王座争夺为她血腥特征的下一步。除了力量，她没有其他的要求。但这种力量很可能足以让她成为女王。

en:
Thane Greymane is a Wolf Clan legend. He is the prince of the ruling Greymane clan, a revered Swordmaster, and the wielder of the mythical Hakonsblade. The young wolf's talent and pedigree are undeniable, even to his enemies.

Thane takes to his reputation with gusto, and a healthy dose of overconfidence. He will do anything to prove his worth to the Wolf Clan. As such, he will stand fast, blade in hand, against any threat to that dream.

Behind Thane's bluster hides a sheltered child of royalty. His lot in life was always as a trophy warrior for the royal line, while his father, and his older brother Fang, shouldered the burden of clan leadership.

This comfortable life was torn away from Thane when his father was killed and Fang was banished from the Wolf Clan. All of a sudden, the hopes and dreams of a thousand souls spun towards Thane for guidance. It was a burden which the young cub's shoulders were perhaps not yet ready to bear.

Now, Thane strikes out into Armello. Tragedy has forced a dangerous duty upon him. With blade in hand, he howls a challenge out to all those that oppose him. Blademaster, tactician, spiritual adept, or steadfast loyalist, no matter what you may think of the Winter Wolf, he is here, and his effect on the Kingdom will be undeniable.
zh_official:
塞恩·格雷迈恩是狼族的传奇人物。他是统治的格雷迈恩族的王子、德高望重的剑客，也是神话中哈肯之刃的主人。这位青年狼的天赋和血统是不可否认的，即使是对他的敌人来说也是不可否认的。

塞恩兴致勃勃并超级自负地赢得声誉。他愿意做任何事情来向狼族证明自己的价值。因此，他将手握刀剑，站稳脚跟，反抗任何威胁他那个梦想的事情。

塞恩气势汹汹的背后隐藏着一个受庇护的皇族孩童。他的一生总作为皇家军队尊贵的战士，而他的父亲和哥哥尖牙却背负了部族首领的重担。

但当父亲被杀害，尖牙被驱逐出狼族时，塞恩这种舒适的生活就被剥夺了。突然之间，上千个灵魂的希望和梦想萦绕着塞恩，寻求指引。这个重担对于年轻的幼崽来说，可能太过沉重无法负担。

现在，塞恩要向阿门罗出击。悲剧迫使他承担了危险的责任。他手执刀剑，向所有反对他的人发出挑战。也许你认为他是剑圣、战术家，或者精神上游刃有余，又或是坚定忠诚。但无论你怎么想，冬狼他都在这里，对王国的影响也无法否认。

塞恩气势汹汹的背后隐藏着一个受庇护的皇族孩童。他的一生总作为皇家军队尊贵的战士，而他的父亲和哥哥方却背负了部族首领的重担。

但当父亲被杀害，方被驱逐出狼族时，塞恩这种舒适的生活就被剥夺了。突然之间，上千个灵魂的希望和梦想萦绕着塞恩，寻求指引。这个重担对于年轻的幼崽来说，可能太过沉重无法负担。

现在，塞恩要向阿门罗出击。悲剧迫使他承担了危险的责任。他手执刀剑，向所有反对他的人发出挑战。也许你认为他是剑圣、战术家，或者精神上游刃有余，又或是坚定忠诚。但无论你怎么想，冬狼他都在这里，对王国的影响也无法否认。

en:
Rangers were once the secret weapon of the Wolf Clan. It was a sacred traditional role, given to only the most talented survivalists, who are capable of enduring the harsh winters at Armello's frozen edges. River, ranger through and through, has spent her life in the wilds, and excelled in every element of the deadly Wolven Hunt.

Rangers forsake their lineage upon joining the ranks of the Wolven Hunt. River never knew her mother, father, or sisters. But during her life, she'd notice a certain glint in the eyes of other Rangers. Although she never had it confirmed, she felt her family all around her throughout her life. It is for that family that she fights. During the tragic events that lead to the exile of Fang Greymane, most every ranger was massacred. Only River survived the deadly slaughter.

Armed with a bow, a dagger, and a naturally sharp mind, River has spent her life outmaneuvering deadly opponents, and relying solely on herself for guidance. Now, from her unique perspective as an outsider, but sworn defender of the realm, she recognizes the need for a new breed of ruler. One who will not fall into the petty squabbles and cushy failings of the past. One who will stand fast in battle, wise in counsel, and who knows how to survive upon the lonely throne.

Armello needs a Ranger.
zh_official:
护林者曾经是狼族的秘密武器。这是一个神圣的传统角色。只有最有才华的生存专家，才能在阿门罗冰冻的边缘忍受严冬。里弗一直是护林者，她一生都在野外度过，在最致命的狼群狩猎的每一个环节表现得都很出色。

护林者在加入狼群狩猎的行列后，便放弃了他们的血统。里弗不认识她的母亲、父亲或姐妹。但在她的一生中，她会注意到其他护林者的眼睛里某种闪烁着的光。虽然她从来没有得到证实，但她能感受到她的家人一直就在身边。她是为家族而战的。在导致尖牙流亡的悲惨事件中，基本上所有护林者都被屠杀了。只有里弗在那场屠杀中幸存下来。

拥有敏锐头脑的里弗装备着弓箭和匕首，一生都致力于击败厉害的对手，并完全依靠自己指引自己的道路。现在，作为局外人拥有独特视角，同时又誓死捍卫国度的她，认识到统治者需要新的血统——一个不会陷入过去的小纷争和小失败的人，一个在战斗中立于不败之地、能给出聪明建议的人，一个知道如何孤独的王座上生存下去的人。

阿门罗需要一个这样的护林者。

en:
Some of the wisest warriors say that you learn more in defeat than in victory. Through failure, one understands the nature of the struggle at a deeper level, and can parlay that knowledge into great mastery in the future.

Magna would disagree. She has never lost, and she's the best.

Part of an order of Wolven warriors called the Shieldmaidens, Magna devoted her life to the protection of Wolf Clan royalty. This noble calling was thrown into chaos when the Greymane Alpha was killed by the traitor Fang, and the well meaning but ultimately useless pup Thane was shunted into the role of prince.

No. Not this time. Magna has lost too many friends and spilled too much blood to see her work tarnished by an unworthy champion. But even after searching throughout the Wolf Clan for a champion she could put her faith in, she found no hero worthy of the greatest shieldmaiden's protection.

Only then, did Magna see her role in the future of Armello.

In this new age, lineage means nothing. The only virtues that should hold the throne are strength and willpower. Shield in hand, Magna is a bastion of both. Now, she strides forward to claim the crown for herself, and forge a new age of glory for Armello.
zh_official:
聪明的战士说过，人能从失败中学到的东西比在胜利中学到的更多。通过失败，人们才能从更深层次上理解斗争的本质， 并能将这些知识转化为未来的掌控力。

麦格纳不会同意这些观点。她从未失败过，她就是最厉害的。

有一部分狼战士叫做盾之室女，麦格纳一生都在保护狼族的王室成员。格雷迈恩·阿尔法被尖牙这个叛徒杀死后，这个崇高的使命被弃至，而善意但又无用的小狗塞恩被迫扛起王子这个角色。

不，麦格纳失去了太多的朋友，洒了太多的鲜血，她不想看到她的成果被一个不值得的战士玷污。但即使她为了找到能信任的战士而找遍了整个狼族，也没有找到那个能让最伟大的盾之室女保护的勇士。

那时，麦格纳才在阿门罗的未来看到了自己的角色。

在这个新的时代，血统一钱不值。力量和意志力才是能支撑王座的美德。麦格纳手握盾牌，是这两种美德坚实的壁垒。现在她大步向前迈进，准备为自己夺取皇冠，为阿门罗打造了一个辉煌的新时代。

en:
As a cub, Fang looked out on a crowd of grizzled wolven citizens as they swore allegiance to him. Prince of the Wolf Clan. Next in line to the harshest and most powerful clan to ever climb the peaks of Armello. Years later, he would look upon the same crowd as they jeered, spat, and cast him away from his home. Prince to exile. Everything to nothing.

Fang is a berserker. His fearlessness and aptitude for risk permeates every aspect of his life. After years witnessing his father struggle vainly against the savage politics of the realm, Fang gambled his fate upon the manipulation of the Rot. When his gamble failed, he was cast out, replaced by Thane, his younger brother, and forced to live apart from his clan, while the dark power of the Rot festered in his body.

Now, as the struggle for the throne reaches its bloody peak, Fang has emerged from the far reaches of Armello. What little remained of his regal bearing is gone, replaced by a primal savagery that strikes fear into the hearts of even the most hardened enemies.

Fang's claim to the throne doesn't come from nobility, blood, or even a sense of duty. It comes from the application of primal law. To the most powerful, goes the throne. To that who has the strength to take it, goes the spoils of the Kingdom.

Fang will take Armello, or die trying.
zh_official:
身为幼崽的尖牙看着这群灰白色狼族市民——他们誓死效忠他，狼族的王子，这个最残酷和最强大种族的下一任继承者，以后将爬上阿门罗的顶峰。多年后，同样也是这群人，他们嘲笑他，向他吐口水，并把他逐出了家园。从王子到流亡，从拥有一切到一无所有。

尖牙是名狂战士，他的无畏和冒险才能渗透在他生活的方方面面。在见证了父亲与王国野蛮政治斗争的多年后，尖牙决定把自己的命运赌在对腐化的操纵上。他这场赌注失败后，遭到驱逐。弟弟塞恩将他取而代之，他也被迫与他的种族分开，同时腐化的黑暗势力却在他的身体里滋长开来。

现在，随着争夺王位的斗争达到了血腥的顶峰，尖牙也从远方走向阿门罗。他的帝王风度所剩无几，取而代之的是一种原始的野蛮行为，即使是最坚强的敌人也会倍感恐惧。

尖牙对王位的欲望并非来自他的贵族身、血统或是责任感，而是源自原始的规律——最强大的人会登上王座，有实力登上王座的人将获取王国的战利品。

尖牙要么终将夺取阿门罗，要么就亡于尝试的路上。

en:
We care about your data and privacy and want to give you more control.

To that end, there are now two ways to play Armello, including a fully private, Offline mode with no identifiable data collection and no online features.

Remember, with respect to international data protection laws, by playing Armello you accept League of Geeks' Privacy Policy, Terms of Service and Armello's EULA. We also use analytics and data collection to improve the Armello experience and run its essential services. If you do not consent to data collection or are considered a child in your country of residence you MUST play in Offline mode.
zh_official:
我们时刻关切您的数据和隐私以及想给玩家更多自由控制的权利。

最终，现在推出两种能够游玩《阿门罗》的方法，包括一种全面隐私、无需收集任何认证数据的离线模式以及无线上功能的模式。

请注意，关于国际数据保护法，通过游玩《阿门罗》将默认您接受League of Geeks的隐私政策、服务条款和《阿门罗》的EULA （终端用户许可协议）条款。我们同时也在使用分析和数据收集以优化《阿门罗》的游玩体验和运行其必要的服务。如果您不同意数据收集或者身处的居住国家/地区将您视为儿童的话，请务必游玩离线模式。
zh:
我们关心你的数据和隐私，并希望给你更多控制权。

为此，现在有两种游玩《阿门罗》的方式，其中一种是完全私密的离线模式，不收集任何可识别数据，也没有在线功能。

请注意，根据国际数据保护法，游玩《阿门罗》即表示你接受 League of Geeks 的隐私政策、服务条款和《阿门罗》EULA。我们还会使用分析和数据收集来改善《阿门罗》体验并运行其必要服务。如果你不同意数据收集，或在你居住的国家/地区被视为儿童，则必须游玩离线模式。
